model: five-fold cross-fitted fit-only mid-ECDF nonnegative simplex blend of atomic v80, v85, and v87
hypothesis: the v87 commute and charging infrastructure representation contains residual ranking signal not captured by the promoted v80-v85 blend and can add at least 0.0001 OOF AUC with all five meta holdouts improving

transform.name: FIT_ONLY_MID_ECDF
transform.fit_scope: separately per member inside each meta-train

weight_search.constraints: nonnegative weights summing exactly to one
weight_search.tie_break_1: minimum L1 distance to that fold's independently reconstructed v90 weights (w80_base, w85_base, 0)
weight_search.tie_break_3: minimum absolute distance to v85 weight 0.5

baseline_reconstruction.protocol: recompute v90 v80-v85 grid selection independently inside every identical meta-train fold
baseline_reconstruction.tie_break_1: minimum absolute distance to v85 weight 0.5
